definition: Concept Searching Limited was a software company that specialized in information retrieval software.
details: It created products for enterprise search, taxonomy management, and statistical classification.
story: Picture a scoreboard at a science fair: you need a fair, agreed way to tell who actually won. A fair scoreboard keeps everyone honest. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. A good metric is a ruler that does not bend when you lean on it. And that, done honestly, is Concept Searching Limited.
